# 74LS95B - 4-bit parallel-access shift register

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74LS95B.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74LS95B.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SER | input |  | serial input (shift right enters here into QA) |
| 2 | A | input |  |  |
| 3 | B | input |  |  |
| 4 | C | input |  |  |
| 5 | D | input |  |  |
| 6 | MODE | input |  | mode control: high = parallel load (and shift left) on clock 2, low = shift right on clock 1 |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | CK2 | clock |  | falling edge; clock 2, left shift / load; acts on its high-to-low edge while MODE is high |
| 9 | CK1 | clock |  | falling edge; clock 1, right shift; acts on its high-to-low edge while MODE is low |
| 10 | QD | output | totem-pole |  |
| 11 | QC | output | totem-pole |  |
| 12 | QB | output | totem-pole |  |
| 13 | QA | output | totem-pole |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | QA = FFA | Shows flip-flop A. |
| 12 | QB = FFB | Shows flip-flop B. |
| 11 | QC = FFC | Shows flip-flop C. |
| 10 | QD = FFD | Shows flip-flop D. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: falling edge of CK2 (MODE high) or of CK1 (MODE low)

- MODE high, CK2 falls: QA-QD = A-D (parallel load)
- MODE low, CK1 falls: shift right, QA = SER, QB = old QA, QC = old QB, QD = old QC
- MODE high: CK1 has no effect; MODE low: CK2 has no effect
- Shift left is a parallel load with QB wired to A, QC to B, QD to C and serial data at D
- MODE should normally change only while both clocks are low; the last five lines of the function table show the other cases where the register still holds

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 8 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74LS95B figures (book page 7-93). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CK1 or CK2 | any Q | PLH | 18 | 27 |
| CK1 or CK2 | any Q | PHL | 21 | 32 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| clock frequency | CK1 or CK2 |  |  | 25 | 36 |
| pulse width | CK1 or CK2 |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | A-D, SER | clock | 20 |  |  |
| hold | A-D, SER | clock | 10 |  |  |
| setup | MODE | CK1 | 20 |  |  |
| setup | MODE | CK2 | 20 |  |  |
| inhibit | MODE | CK1 | 20 |  |  |
| inhibit | MODE | CK2 | 20 |  |  |

## Not known

- Figure 2 (the waveform that defines the enable/inhibit times) was not read; the reference edges of those four limits are not settled.
- Pin names SER, MODE, CK1, CK2 are short forms of the datasheet's SERIAL INPUT, MODE CONTROL, CLOCK 1 R-SHIFT and CLOCK 2 L-SHIFT (LOAD).

## Notes

Exact-name file: the family rule cannot reach a type that ends in a letter. The book also shows SN7495A and SN74L95 on the same pages; those figures are not in this file.
